description: Free. The Rightshold Gate policy check websites use on incoming agent traffic: verifies an RS-KYA token (or a claimed handle) and an optional Rights Receipt against the site's policy (min_kya_level, require_kya, require_receipt, require_cleared, allow_agents, deny_agents) and answers allow or deny with reasons.
name: gate_check
title: Gate: may a site accept this agent or upload?
